author: fester
body: The stub: 1. Saves callee-saved regs and SystemTable 2. Calls AllocatePages for kernel region at 0x100000 3. Copies text + rodata to allocated pages 4. Calls ExitBootServices 5. Sets up identity-mapped page tables (4-level, 4KB granule) 6. Configures MAIR_EL1, TCR_EL1, TTBR0_EL1, SCTLR_EL1 7. Sets SP, x28 (heap), branches to kernel opening
